title: BUGFIX — P1 live pipeline: InsightAgent static fallback when 0 qualified clips
rationale: Sprint 1321 skips ClipDetection when ViralDownloader returns 0 clips. Result: qualifiedClips=[], InsightAgent not called in live mode, briefs=[], ScriptAgent not called, pipeline exits with 0 videos. This has been happening since RapidAPI lapsed (403 from ViralDownloader). Fix: add else branch for live mode with 0 clips — call getMockInsightBriefs() so pipeline still produces deterministic content. Combined with Sprint 1355 ScriptAgent fallback, live mode will now generate ~5 videos per run even without viral clips.

tasks.description: In agents/scs001-orchestrator/index.ts: add else branch after mock InsightAgent fallback — in live mode with 0 qualified clips, use getMockInsightBriefs() to keep pipeline producing content.
